messages:
maria.chen: Heads-up — putting a proposal here for a continuous acceptance + customer-adapter lanes approach for model onboarding. Aim: reduce manual gating, give customers opt-in compatibility shims, and create clearer rollback signals. Feedback by EOD Fri please.
kevin.patel: sounds good. can you list the concrete acceptance metrics we’d gate on? p95 latency / cost / quality?
maria.chen: exactly. initial proposal: p95 latency <= 120ms (default instance class), token-cost delta <= +10% vs current pinned model, hallucination/regression < 2% on the model-specific eval set, end-to-end semantic parity for top-k rerank (>= 98% relative). also require CI pass on the "smoke prompts" suite.
anya: add a mandatory prompt-set for customer-owned prompts (opt-in) and a per-customer diff report. we should surface examples where tokenization changes cause output shifts.
sam: +1. we also need a pin-overrides policy: paying customers can request a per-customer pin until they validate. How do adapters work?
maria.chen: adapter = a lightweight compatibility layer (tokenizer mapping + post-process shim) that runs as a pre/post transform for that customer. intended for short-lived cutovers (30–90 days). it’s opt-in and auditable.
leo.kim: infra questions — load generation for latency tests and canary ratios? proposing: 1% canary of live traffic for 24h with synthetic load ramp to validate KV-cache warmup. rollback if error rate > 1% or p95 degrades > 20% vs baseline.
kevin.patel: we should also track cost-per-1k tokens and have automated rollback if cost delta > 25% for 24h. billing impact needs to surface in the rollout ticket.
maria.chen: agreed. sample rollout config (POC):
```json
{
  "model": "open-xyz-7b-v2",
  "canary_percent": 1,
  "canary_duration_minutes": 1440,
  "acceptance_metrics": {
    "p95_latency_ms": 120,
    "token_cost_delta_pct": 10,
    "hallucination_pct": 2,
    "semantic_parity_pct": 98
  },
  "fallback": "pin-to-previous",
  "adapter_enabled": true
}
```
anya: nice. make sure the config ties into the eval-harness so we can auto-run the regression suite pre-rollout and post-canary.
sam: for customer communication we need a one-pager: what adapter means, how long it lasts, and how to request pin overrides. legal should sign off on SLA language for the pin window.
product-bot: Reminder: Roadmap sync Tue 10:00 — add this as an agenda item under "catalog governance".
kevin.patel: one more ask — add a small randomized A/B to surface qualitative signals (user satisfaction survey prompt) for a subset of canary traffic.
maria.chen: will add. next steps: I’ll update the proposal doc with thresholds + the adapter lifecycle and draft the customer comms + ticket template for pin requests. Scheduling a 30m design review Mon 11:00. thanks all :pray:
__note: Messages are ordered chronologically, each prefixed by sender name. This thread captures a short product sync around model onboarding acceptance, adapters, canaries, and rollout criteria.
